title: FarSky: Task-Aware Latent-Space Coupling for Generative Intra-Hour Solar Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.11254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate solar irradiance forecasting is essential for the reliable integration of photovoltaic power into modern electricity grids. All-sky imagers (ASI) provide high-resolution observations of clouds, making them well suited for intra-hour forecasting. Recent deep learning approaches have substantially improved forecast accuracy but are often limited by deterministic predictions and a reduced capability to anticipate ramp events. This work proposes FarSky, a generative forecasting framework that leverages latent-space coupling to learn task-aware representations of sky images. A multi-task autoencoder first learns a shared latent representation for image reconstruction and irradiance estimation. A latent diffusion model then generates future latent states conditioned on recent observations, from which irradiance forecasts are directly decoded. translated_title: FarSky：面向生成式小时级太阳预报的任务感知潜在空间耦合
translated_abstract: 准确的太阳辐照度预报对于光伏发电可靠地接入现代电网至关重要。全天空成像仪（ASI）提供高分辨率的云层观测数据，非常适合用于小时级预报。近年来，深度学习方法显著提高了预报精度，但往往受限于确定性预测，并且对爬坡事件的预测能力不足。本文提出了FarSky，一种生成式预报框架，利用潜在空间耦合来学习天空图像的任务感知表示。一个多任务自编码器首先学习用于图像重建和辐照度估计的共享潜在表示。然后，一个潜在扩散模型根据近期观测生成未来的潜在状态，并从中直接解码辐照度预测。通过随机采样，天然地获得概率预报。该框架...
tldr: FarSky提出了一种结合多任务自编码器和潜在扩散模型的生成式预报框架，通过潜在空间耦合学习任务感知的天空图像表示，实现小时级太阳辐照度的概率预报，并提升了对爬坡事件的预测能力。
en_tdlr: FarSky proposes a generative forecasting framework that couples a multi-task autoencoder and a latent diffusion model to learn task-aware sky-image representations, enabling probabilistic intra-hour solar irradiance forecasts with improved ramp-event prediction.
